verdict.rationale: Recurly documents an official public MCP server, Recurly Compass MCP. The docs say it lets AI agents such as Claude Desktop or Cursor work directly with Recurly's tools and APIs without complex setup, and a probe confirmed the documentation page is live. However, one description frames it mainly as access to documentation and API knowledge, so it is unclear whether agents can act on live account data. Missing for 10: a documented tool list and auth/setup details, clarity on live account operations versus docs-only knowledge, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
